thag2.46:1.1: Nadanti morā susikhā supekhuṇā sunīlagīvā sumukhā sugajjino, susaddalā cāpi mahāmahī ayaṃ subyāpitambu, suvalāhakaṃ nabhaṃ. || ||
thag2.46:2.1: sukallarūpo sumanassa jhāyitaṃ sunikkhamo sādhu subuddhasāsane; susukkasukkaṃ nipuṇaṃ sududdasaṃ phusāhi taṃ uttamam accutaṃ padan ti. || || Cūḷako thero.
